claims: Integrity is the name of the Orion spacecraft for the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is to carry four astronauts around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day test flight to orbit the Moon verifying systems for future lunar landings.
The Artemis II mission crew includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Orion spacecraft features updated environmental control.
The Orion spacecraft has a fully functional Launch Abort System.
The Orion spacecraft has new displays.
The Orion spacecraft has an experimental laser communication system.
The European Service Module features solar array wings with 15,000 cells each.
The European Service Module's solar array wings have a 63-foot wingspan.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) and Orion together.
The name "Integrity" was chosen to symbolize the shared values of NASA and the Canadian Space Agency in the pursuit of exploration.
